description: This file defines the Sale class in the Opencart admin extension, specifically in the report namespace. It contains methods for retrieving various sales-related statistics and data, such as total sales, orders per country, orders per day, week, month, and year, as well as tax details. It extends the core Model class from Opencart's system engine.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: A model class for handling sales data and statistics within the Opencart admin report namespace.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates the total sales sum, optionally filtered by date.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Returns total order count and sum grouped by country.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Provides total orders grouped by each day, calendar week, or other groupings.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Returns total order counts grouped by week, over the past week.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Provides total orders segmented by month.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Returns total order count per year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves order details with various aggregations and filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Calculates total number of orders, optionally filtered.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Fetches tax-related data for orders, including total tax value and order count.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Calculates total tax amounts, with grouping options such as day, week, month, year.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Retrieves shipping data including date ranges, totals, and order counts.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Gets total shipping cost, grouped by day, week, month, year.
